"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Visionary management of capital was the lifeblood of the entire economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Responsible access to credit helped small businesses grow, created jobs, and made Americans the best-housed people in history.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Funding innovation by financial services underwrote the future.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Most financial institutions were responsible and healthy, especially those closest to their investors and borrowers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In cases of malfeasance or other criminal behavior, the full force of the law should be used.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"No financial institution is too big to fail.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The taxpayers must never again be on the hook for the losses of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The public must never again be left holding the bag for Wall Street giants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration's record of over-regulation and selective intervention has already frozen investment and job creation.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration's record of over-regulation and selective intervention threatens to make financial institutions the coddled wards of government.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
